note: Hand-derived from canonicalSecurityGroupSGRuleEdgeUpsertCypherFormat (go/internal/storage/cypher/cloud/aws/security/group/security_reachability_edge_writer.go): `MATCH (sg:CloudResource {uid: row.sg_uid}) MATCH (rule:SecurityGroupRule {uid: row.rule_uid}) MERGE (sg)-[rel:%s]->(rule)`. The one %s fills per row from the closed direction vocabulary screened by validateSecurityGroupAllowsRelType, so ALLOWS_INGRESS and ALLOWS_EGRESS are the only types this writer can emit. Each source is a reducer.cloudjoin.CloudResourceUID value = sha256 over account_id, region, resource_type, resource_id: account_id 123456789012 and region us-east-1 everywhere, with (resource_type, resource_id) pairs (aws_ec2_security_group, sg-0abc123def456789a) for the first two edges and (aws_ec2_security_group, sg-0def123456789abcd) for the last three. Each target is the port-precise SecurityGroupRule uid folding sg_uid, direction, protocol, normalized port range, and source. Exactly five edges: web-sg ingress tcp 22 from 10.0.0.0/8 (ALLOWS_INGRESS), web-sg egress tcp 443 to 10.0.0.0/8 (ALLOWS_EGRESS, the direction proving the second vocabulary member), db-sg ingress tcp 80 from prefix list pl-0abc123def456789a, db-sg ingress tcp 5432 from referenced sg-0ref123456789abcd, and db-sg ingress udp 53 from 2001:db8::/32 (ALLOWS_INGRESS). The other four rules contribute nothing on purpose -- one anchored to unscanned ghost-sg (unresolved anchor), one referencing unscanned ghost-sg (unresolved endpoint), one with unknown source, and one tombstoned. The MERGE keys on its two endpoint nodes alone, so there is no identity block and no asserted properties.
